description: Core permissions for all windows (events + window management for detached sequence viewers) plus persisted window geometry. `set-title` drives the workspace/file window title; `destroy` is required merely by REGISTERING onCloseRequested -- the JS helper calls destroy() itself whenever the handler does not preventDefault(), so without it even a clean close throws. The `opener` plugin is deliberately NOT granted: the webview must go through cmd_open's validating commands.
